_sources: Prices: ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing, read 2026-11-26 (gemini-3.8-flash doubles on 2027-01-01; thinking bills as output). INR: open.er-api.com 2026-11-25, 92.93, rounded to 93. Meeting hour: cost study T-05688efa, 2026-11-26: Gemini transcription of about 60 min of speech (90k audio tokens in, 12.6k out on gemini-3.5-transcribe), one notes call (about 17k in, 5k out, estimated) and about Rs 1 of chat. Profiles: owner is the owner's measured pace (about 160 dictations a month, 2026-11-12 to 11-18) plus 4 meeting hours, which is the cost study's estimate until usage.sqlite gives the real figure; typical and heavy from the cost study.
_gate: C1 is scored on the owner profile at the highest announced prices: under Rs 250 a month is the gate (90), Rs 200 or less is 100. Typical use is reported as a check; heavy is reported, not gated. Meetings stay on Gemini.
_cache: cache_hit_share_in_use: share of prompt text billed at the cached rate in real use. 0 until the app's usage log (cachedIn) measures it; the eval's own hit share is optimistic because its calls run back to back.
